data.title: RA1N Residence
data.about:
Immerse yourself in the luxurious lifestyle at Rain Residence, a flagship project by Object One Real Estate Development located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai. This state-of-the-art 25-story residential tower is a testament to modern living, elegantly designed with a harmonious blend of minimalist architectural lines, glass cladding, and a natural color scheme that captures the essence of sophisticated urban living. 

Rain Residence stands as a beacon of contemporary design, offering an array of residential choices including sleek 1 to 2 bedroom apartments and 2 bedroom signature apartments. Each residence is exquisitely crafted with the homeowner's comfort in mind, featuring practical and spacious layouts, calming finishes, and interiors that epitomize functional elegance.

The Rain Residence is dedicated to enhancing the well-being of its residents, providing a tranquil environment where every detail, from the cool hues of light gray and white exteriors to the serene blue interior accents, pools, and water features, is meticulously curated to evoke a sense of peace, tranquility, and refreshment, akin to the rejuvenating experience of a gentle rain shower in Dubai's vibrant landscape.

location_tile.title: In the Centre of It All at Rain Residence JVC
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the vibrant heart of New Dubai, RA1N Residence boasts an enviable location in JVC, rapidly emerging as a hub of dynamic development. This premier destination is synonymous with convenience, offering easy access to a plethora of amenities, including top-tier daycare centers, schools, parks (boasting over 30 green spaces), supermarkets, restaurants, fitness centers, and swimming pools—all within a stone's throw.

Strategically positioned, residents can effortlessly navigate to major thoroughfares such as Mohammed Bin Rashid Road, Barsha Road, and Al Khail Road, ensuring a smooth commute to key business sectors like Dubai Marina, Dubai Internet City, and JLT, all while avoiding the hassle of traffic congestion. RA1N Residence by Object1 epitomizes the essence of modern living in Dubai: a serene community vibe coupled with prime access to the city's work and leisure destinations. Discover the perfect blend of accessibility and tranquility at RA1N Residence, where life in Dubai's JVC is redefined.

  • 15 Minutes to Burj Khalifa / Burj Al Arab

  • 20 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach

  • 28 Minutes to Dubai World Centre
